subject.title: feat(diagnostics-otel): add vendor-neutral session attribute option for OTel session grouping

question: Which reset-bounded telemetry identity and attribute set should diagnostics-otel support as its permanent privacy contract?
rationale: Source inspection can establish that `sessionKey` has the wrong lifetime, but only the diagnostics owner can choose whether OpenClaw should expose a pseudonymous conversation identifier and which external semantic conventions become supported API.

options.title: Reset-bounded generic identity
options.body: Hash `sessionId`, emit `session.id`, and expose `gen_ai.conversation.id` only under the existing GenAI semantic-convention opt-in, omitting redundant `langfuse.session.id`.

options.title: Three-key compatibility contract
options.body: Hash `sessionId` but deliberately emit all three keys, documenting the vendor-specific alias and semantic-convention exception as supported behavior.

options.title: Keep mapping outside OpenClaw
options.body: Reject the new core config surface and require collectors or backend-specific integrations to map an approved existing identifier.

recommendation.title: Reset-bounded generic identity
recommendation.body: Hash `sessionId`, emit `session.id`, and expose `gen_ai.conversation.id` only under the existing GenAI semantic-convention opt-in, omitting redundant `langfuse.session.id`.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent diagnostics-otel migration, attribute, and privacy-hardening history makes this the strongest available owner for the telemetry contract decision.
